rules.description: Allow up to 5% deleted records due to OECD dataflow 2.5 NUTS 2024 regional restructuring and historical series revisions.
Ensure MaxDate is uniform across all StatVars
Ensure MaxDate is fresh within allowable 2-year reporting lag for OECD annual data

params.condition: CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= date_part('year', current_date) - 2
